crop.notes: Joined clippings of one article: the Sullivan visit and the East St. Louis exhibition.

ocr.notes: OCR text of two parts joined; names and gist readable

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, November 4, 1883. Visit was on November 3.

facts.fact: John L. Sullivan, on a visit to St. Louis with his company, spent time in Tom Kelly's and Tom Allen's saloons on Market street; in Allen's place the party retired to a room and drank champagne, though Sullivan drank nothing
places: Tom Allen's saloon, Market street, St. Louis

notes: Allen appears only as saloon host, and as a name Jim Miles said he could hold his own against at the East St. Louis exhibition (not a fact about Allen).
